title: RPCS3 0.0.35-17691: official stable release
summary: RPCS3 published 0.0.35-17691 on March 24, 2025. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 3 emulator project.

blocks.text: The RPCS3 project published version 0.0.35-17691 on March 24, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The release record publishes a SHA-256 checksum (8d6821a29be47c127e7dbffca8ff6e425267876c2dadb3354f4edc27f2fa759b) and records an archive size of 37036239 bytes, approximately 37.0 MB. These values identify the distributed build without relying on an external summary.
